rules.check: Every footprint inside the floor polygon
No two solid footprints intersect (rugs and mats are ignored)
Locked items are never moved by the agent or solver
Door swing arc + DOOR_CLEAR_M in front of each door stays empty
Beds and desks keep one ACCESS_EDGE_M free long edge; storage keeps STORAGE_FRONT_M in front
Items taller than the sill stay out of the WINDOW_BAND_M band
A requested clear zone exists as one free rectangle
Flood fill over free cells connects the door to every bed and desk
